description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'SecurePrefs' that manages secure and non-secure preferences for an Android app, including encrypted storage of sensitive data, managing app configurations, and user preferences.

classes.name: SecurePrefs
classes.description: Main class handling secure and regular preferences, including encryption, preference migration, and managing various app-specific settings.

methods.name: setLastDiscoveredStableId
methods.description: Sets the last discovered stable ID string.

methods.name: setCameraEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the camera feature.

methods.name: setLocationMode
methods.description: Sets the location mode for the app.

methods.name: setManualEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables manual gateway configuration.

methods.name: setManualHost
methods.description: Sets the manual gateway host address.

methods.name: setManualTls
methods.description: Enables or disables TLS for manual gateway.

methods.name: setGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Stores the gateway bootstrap token securely.

methods.name: setCanvasDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables canvas debug status.

methods.name: getNotificationForwardingPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the notification forwarding policy for a given app package.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingPackages
methods.description: Updates the list of packages for notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours
methods.description: Configures quiet hours for notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMaxEventsPerMinute
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of notification events per minute.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the session key for notification forwarding.

methods.name: loadGatewayToken
methods.description: Loads the stored gateway token, falling back to secure storage.

methods.name: loadGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Retrieves stored TLS fingerprint for a gateway.

methods.name: saveGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Saves TLS fingerprint for a gateway.
